desc: The ATLAS ambidextrous charging handle is a simple and affordable upgrade that will substantially increase the use of your AR-15. Easily grab on either side of the handle and you can quickly charge your rifle even with large gloves with the textured grooves that are cut into the latch handles. The total width of the latches measures 2.76". Made entirely out of a solid block of 7075-T6 aluminum for added strength and durability!
